A '''black hole''' was located in the [[Black Hole sector]], situated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] exerted a powerful [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull so as to prevent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in its vicinity from escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Due to this obstacle, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]] became stranded near the black hole on the ship ''[[Random Mallet]]''. The [[Plunder Moon]] was a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] within the region of the black hole; it was close enough to be reached using [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]].

The black hole is somehow on the last leg of a route to Chiss Space (f-8 to f-9), on the route to the Delphon System (k-18), and on the route from Coruscant to Ketaris (l-5 to l-9).
